# Set-Up

## Libraries

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(biscale)
library(patchwork)
library(ggnewscale)
```

## Project Specific Functions

```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```

## Plotting Defaults

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


# Import Data

## RTS

```{r}
rts_pt <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson")
rts_poly <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_poly.geojson")
```

## RTS Probability

```{r}
rts_prob <- rast(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/sdm/gbm_kfold_10_pred_tuned_median_v.3.1.0_filter.tif'
) |>
  project(vect(rts_pt))
```

## Domain

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_south_clean.geojson")
hex_domains <- list.files(
  "./01_processed_data",
  pattern = "hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k_domain.geojson",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  str_sort(decreasing = TRUE, numeric = TRUE)

hex_names <- map(
  hex_domains,
  ~ .x |> str_extract("hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k")
)

hex_domains <- map(
  hex_domains,
  ~ st_read(.x)
)

names(hex_domains) <- hex_names
```

## Hex Grids

```{r}
hex_grids <- list.files(
  "./01_processed_data",
  pattern = "hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k.geojson",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  str_sort(decreasing = TRUE, numeric = TRUE)

hex_names <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ .x |> str_extract("hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k")
)

hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ st_read(.x)
)

names(hex_grids) <- hex_names
rm(hex_names)
```

## RTS Regions

```{r}
regions <- st_read("./01_processed_data/rts_regions.geojson")
```

## NaturalEarth

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  select(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
```

```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>
  filter(name == "Russia") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31
russia$geometry[29] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[29], dist = 0.11)
russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
    .by = c(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
  )

world <- world |>
  filter(name != "Russia") |>
  rbind(russia)


world_north <- world %>%
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(crop_poly) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt))
```

# Extract RTS Probability in Hex Grid

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ terra::extract(
    rts_prob,
    .x,
    fun = max,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    ID = FALSE,
    bind = TRUE
  ) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    mutate(
      rts_prob = case_when(
        !is.nan(median) ~ median,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    ) |>
    select(-median)
)
```

```{r}
map(
  hex_grids,
  function(.x) {
    # RTS Count (Modeled)
    ggplot(data = .x) +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = rts_prob))
  }
)
```

```{r}
count_breaks <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ list(
    "rts_modeled_count" = rgeoda::natural_breaks(5, .x["rts_modeled_count"]),
    "rts_prob" = rgeoda::natural_breaks(5, .x["rts_prob"])
  )
)

manual_breaks_rts_count <- list(
  "manual_breaks_100k" = c(0, 10, 100, 1000),
  "manual_breaks_50k" = c(0, 5, 50, 500),
  "manual_breaks_10k" = c(0, 1, 10, 100)
)

manual_breaks_rts_prob <- c(0, 25, 50, 75)
```

```{r}
hex_grids <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  manual_breaks_rts_count,
  ~ .x |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      rts_modeled_count_class = classify_counts(rts_modeled_count, breaks = .y),
      rts_prob_class = classify_counts(
        rts_prob,
        breaks = manual_breaks_rts_prob
      ),
      bi_class_prob = str_flatten(
        c(rts_modeled_count_class, rts_prob_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      mapped_prob_offset = rts_modeled_count_class - rts_prob_class,
      .before = geometry
    )
)
```

# Regional Stats

```{r}
region_stats <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  manual_breaks_rts_count,
  ~ regions |>
    st_join(.x) |>
    summarise(
      across(
        !contains("class") & !contains("idx") & !contains("offset"),
        list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .by = c(name, X, Y, geometry)
    ) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      rts_modeled_count_class = classify_counts(
        rts_modeled_count_mean,
        breaks = .y
      ),
      rts_modeled_count_class_sd = rts_modeled_count_sd /
        (c(.y, max(.x$rts_modeled_count))[rts_modeled_count_class + 1] -
          c(.y, max(.x$rts_modeled_count))[rts_modeled_count_class]),
      rts_prob_class = classify_counts(
        rts_prob_mean,
        breaks = manual_breaks_rts_prob
      ),
      rts_prob_class_sd = rts_prob_sd /
        (c(manual_breaks_rts_prob, 100)[rts_prob_class + 1] -
          c(manual_breaks_rts_prob, 100)[rts_prob_class]),
      bi_class_prob = str_flatten(
        c(rts_modeled_count_class, rts_prob_class),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      mapped_prob_offset = rts_modeled_count_class - rts_prob_class,
      mapped_prob_offset_sd = sqrt(
        rts_modeled_count_class_sd^2 + rts_prob_class_sd^2
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    ungroup()
)
```


# Compare Modeled RTS Counts to RTS Probability

## RTS Counts vs RTS Probability

### Bivariate Maps

```{r}
custom_palette_5 <- c(
  "1-1" = "#FFFFFF",
  "2-1" = "#FFDCD5",
  "3-1" = "#FBB8AC",
  "4-1" = "#F39585",
  "5-1" = "#E8705F",
  "1-2" = "#D4DFEF",
  "2-2" = "#D6BDC5",
  "3-2" = "#D39B9D",
  "4-2" = "#CC7877",
  "5-2" = "#C15552",
  "1-3" = "#A8C0DF",
  "2-3" = "#AD9FB6",
  "3-3" = "#AC7E8F",
  "4-3" = "#A65D69",
  "5-3" = "#9C3A46",
  "1-4" = "#7AA2CE",
  "2-4" = "#8482A6",
  "3-4" = "#856380",
  "4-4" = "#81435B",
  "5-4" = "#781F3A",
  "1-5" = "#4385BE",
  "2-5" = "#596797",
  "3-5" = "#5F4971",
  "4-5" = "#5D2A4E",
  "5-5" = "#55002D"
)
```

Redder colors indicate more RTS were mapped than predicted, while bluer colors indicate fewer RTS were mapped than predicted.

```{r}
bi_legend_location <- c(
  left = 0.81,
  bottom = 0,
  right = 1,
  top = 0.145
)

hex_maps_bi <- pmap(
  list(hex_grids, hex_domains, manual_breaks_rts_count),
  function(grid, domain, breaks) {
    filtered_grid <- grid |>
      filter(!is.na(bi_class_prob))

    map_hex_grid_bi(
      filtered_grid,
      "bi_class_prob",
      "rts_modeled_count",
      "rts_prob",
      domain,
      5,
      breaks,
      manual_breaks_rts_prob,
      custom_palette_5,
      legend_loc = bi_legend_location,
      xlab = "RTS Count (Modeled)",
      ylab = "RTS Probability"
    )
  }
)

hex_maps_bi
```

## Offset Between Mapped RTS Count and RTS Probability

### Univariate Maps
Blue indicates we found a lot of RTS in a low probability area, while red indicates we found fewer RTS than the probability would indicate.

```{r}
count_prob_maps <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  hex_domains,
  function(.x, .y) {
    map_hex_grid(
      .x,
      .y,
      variable = "mapped_prob_offset",
      label = "Mapped RTS Count/\nRTS Probability Offset"
    ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = regions,
        color = "black",
        fill = "transparent",
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      geom_sf_text(
        data = regions,
        aes(label = name)
      ) +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        name = "Mapped RTS Count/\nRTS Probability Offset",
        na.value = "transparent",
        limits = c(-4, 4)
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        name = "Mapped RTS Count/\nRTS Probability Offset",
        na.value = "transparent",
        limits = c(-4, 4)
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal"
      ) +
      coord_sf(expand = FALSE)
  }
)

count_prob_maps
```

### Pixel Counts of RTS Count/RTS Probability Offsets

With a heatmap:
```{r}
map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = rts_prob_class, y = rts_modeled_count_class)) +
    geom_bin2d(binwidth = 1, center = 0) +
    # scale_y_continuous(transform = "log10") +
    # geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = (y ~ exp(x))) +
    scale_fill_viridis() +
    coord_fixed(expand = FALSE)
)
```

With size scaled points:
```{r}
offset_bands <- tibble(
  x = c(
    c(3.75, 5.25),
    c(2.75, 3.75, 5.25),
    c(1.75, 2.75, 5.25),
    c(0.25, 2.75, 3.75),
    c(0.25, 1.75, 2.75),
    c(0.25, 1.75)
  ),
  ymin = c(
    c(0.25, 0.25),
    c(0.25, 0.25, 1.75),
    c(0.25, 0.25, 2.75),
    c(1.75, 4.25, 5.25),
    c(2.75, 4.25, 5.25),
    c(3.75, 5.25)
  ),
  ymax = c(
    c(0.25, 1.75),
    c(0.25, 1.25, 2.75),
    c(0.25, 1.25, 3.75),
    c(2.75, 5.25, 5.25),
    c(3.75, 5.25, 5.25),
    c(5.25, 5.25)
  ),
  band = c(rep(-4, 2), rep(-3, 3), rep(-2, 3), rep(2, 3), rep(3, 3), rep(4, 2))
)

pixel_count_plots <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = rts_prob_class, y = rts_modeled_count_class)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = offset_bands,
      aes(
        x = x,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        fill = band,
        group = band
      ),
      alpha = 0.5,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(guide = "none") +
    geom_count(
      aes(
        size = after_stat(n),
        # color = after_stat(n)
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Pixel Count",
      range = c(2, 10)
    ) +
    # scale_color_viridis(name = "Pixel Count") +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = c(-3.5, -2.5, -1.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5),
      color = c("black", "gray30", "gray60", "gray60", "gray30", "black")
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = tibble(
        x = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5),
        y = c(4.5, 3.5, 2.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
        label = c("+4", "+3", "+2", "-2", "-3", "-4")
      ),
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = tibble(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "RTS Count/\nProbability Offset"),
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "RTS Probability Class",
      limits = c(0.25, 5.25),
      breaks = seq(1, 5),
      labels = c("Low", "", "", "", "High")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "RTS Count Class (Modeled)",
      limits = c(0.25, 5.25),
      breaks = seq(1, 5),
      labels = c("Low", "", "", "", "High")
    ) +
    guides(color = "legend") +
    coord_fixed(expand = FALSE)
)

pixel_count_plots
```

### Regional Characteristics of Offsets

```{r}
region_offset_plots <- map(
  region_stats,
  ~ ggplot(
    .x,
    aes(
      x = name,
      y = mapped_prob_offset
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        x = name,
        ymin = mapped_prob_offset - mapped_prob_offset_sd,
        ymax = mapped_prob_offset + mapped_prob_offset_sd
      ),
      width = 0,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        fill = mapped_prob_offset
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      limits = c(-4, 4),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Region") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Mapped RTS Count/\nRTS Probability Offset")
)
region_offset_plots
```

### Combined Figures

```{r}
final_plots <- pmap(
  list(
    count_prob_maps,
    pixel_count_plots,
    region_offset_plots
  ),
  function(maps, count_plots, region_plots) {
    maps +
      (count_plots / region_plots) +
      plot_layout(widths = c(1.5, 1))
  }
)
final_plots
```
